ctx.x: Yeah, with Papa Celestein, no? Yes, you travelled to the T.O.M.C.E. Papa Celestein. When you first went to Chicago, what band was that, when you first went to Chicago, who did you play with? Oh, I played with Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez. Yeah. Do you remember where that was and about when? Do you remember? Oh, I remember it was at Johnson's Cabaret, and the theatre. Oh, what's the name of the theatre? I was playing with the best piano player out there. What's the name of the theatre? There was a monogram or the…
Do you remember who was in the band? Mm-hm.
